pairs.subject: hash-pinned-translation-pipeline
pairs.evidence: scripts/i18n/emit-guide-status.mjs:68 The emitter suppresses an unpinned translation's missing status when English is unchanged, causing the runtime to claim freshness without the required provenance.

techniques.evidence: scripts/i18n/emit-guide-status.mjs:68 Although the classifier labels unpinned translations missing, this consumer removes that finding; getLocalized.ts:165 then labels the translation fresh.

scripts/i18n/check-guide-translations.mjs:89 Both paths use shared extraction and hash helpers, and the CLI refuses mismatched hashes or population sizes; a read-only comparison found no mismatches across 109 current topics.
scripts/i18n/guide-source.mjs:74 The scope includes translated title, description and body, but stored digests are bare hexadecimal without the required algorithm prefix or scope version.

.github/workflows/ci.yml:71 CI runs structural guide checks while explicitly excluding translation freshness; validating the generated status table does not fail merely because translations remain stale.
scripts/i18n/translate-guide-subagent-prompt.md:233 The translator copies opaque hashes into a final metadata pass, contrary to tooling writing provenance alongside each translated unit.

scripts/i18n/guide-drift.mjs:602 The independent work order provides locale topic counts and diffs, but does not aggregate source volume per locale and verdict; lengths in the separate hash manifest are not a scoped translation budget.
